title: Shinonome Ena — Outstretched Hand〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: One week after the picnic
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Good, I got here ten minutes early...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Ena, you're already here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Airi... I just got here... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yawning like that in the middle of the afternoon. Still a night owl, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But since you're so tired, why don't we hit up a cafe or something first?
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This girl from my group, Minori, works here too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori Hanasato?
Is she in today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, she said she's gonna be busy with dance practice all day today. She's probably hard at work right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see. But she really is amazing. It's almost hard to believe that she's performing alongside former first-rate idols like you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. Her work ethic is incredible.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to meet her sometime if I can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, I'll try and introduce you to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, she even recommended me this special parfait they make here too. This one...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, that looks amazing! I bet it's a like magnet too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It apparently tastes as good as it looks. I think I'll get the green tea version of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then I'll get the strawberry one!
Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, it's been a week since then...
Has anything happened on your end?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
With Mizuki?
Not really, unfortunately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. At least things haven't gotten worse, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I have a feeling that this is gonna take a pretty long time to work out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki has this knack for dodging questions and avoiding people.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I got that. I tried to get a conversation going during the Green Adventure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But every time I thought I had a chance to actually go for it and ask, I sort of wasn't able to commit or get any good answers...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See what I mean? It's like this is turning into a never-ending staring contest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'll make Mizuki regret not telling me sooner.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And I don't expect you to give up anytime soon!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I just want to move past this already.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know what made Mizuki feel that way...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this song isn't able to save you, I'll keep composing until I find the one that does.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need that sort of resolve...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade showed Mafuyu how determined she is...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to do the same...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I sort of just clammed up there, didn't I? Wait, why are you grinning like that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just glad that you're back to your old self.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My old self?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. My favorite part about you is how you can just say or do what's on your mind without a second thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure if that's a compliment or an insult...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course it's a compliment!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might not sound all that great coming from me, but I really do admire that part of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So do what you can for Mizuki, okay? Shizuku and I will help however we can too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right! Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And look at that. Our parfaits are finally here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, they're even better than what we saw in the pictures. Okay, which angle works best...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind giving me a few tips on how to take good pics? It's sort of been a while since we last did this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. No problem!
For something like this, it might be best to...
